worldcombat.skill.confusion.summary: Fire a faint telekinetic pulse that skims the ground in a straight line: it deals special damage on hit and may leave the target dazed. While dazed the target fumbles its actions, and each fumble is jabbed again.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.use.1: Chip health down with repeated light hits
worldcombat.skill.confusion.use.2: Suppress a target that likes to act often
The pulse deals %1$s special damage on hit.
On hit it has a %1$s chance to daze the target for %2$s; while dazed the target's actions are scattered with a %3$s chance, and each fumble is jabbed again.
The pulse reaches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.focus.on: Focused mind: stronger, longer and more reliable daze and a higher fumble chance, at the cost of shorter reach, a thinner hitbox and slower travel.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.focus.off: Loose mind: a faster, longer, cheaper shot, at the cost of lighter damage and rarer daze.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.growth.0: From level %1$s the pulse rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.growth.1: From level %1$s the pulse rises to %2$s power and %3$s daze chance.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.preference.f: On: power x1.18, longer and more reliable daze, higher fumble chance, but reach x0.85, a thinner hitbox, slower travel, +2 ticks wind-up and +5 ticks cooldown — for close suppression. Off (loose mind): a faster, longer, cheaper shot, at the cost of lighter damage and rarer daze.
worldcombat.skill.confusion.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in before firing; larger values let it open from further away.
On: targets already carrying the shared daze identity are ranked last, saving the shot for a clear-headed foe. Off: all targets are equal.
On: lower-health targets rank higher, using the short cooldown to finish them. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
